name: Manual quote-level amount-based (line-level) discount
what_it_tests: A manual fixed-amount discount entered at quote/line level reduces net for an eligible (non-LastTransaction, amend/add/null, non-derived) line; e.g. $5k off a $50k line
proc_mechanism: Manual Quote Level Amount-Based (Line-Level); Manual Quote Level Discount gate (ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction' AND (Amend OR Add OR action IsNull) AND (ItemIsDerived IsNull OR =false))
expected_behavior: Net = list - entered amount; ItemNetTotalPrice recomputed
test_setup: New/Amend non-derived line, ItemDiscountAmount/Manual_Discount_Amount set ($5k off $50k), Qty=2

run3_result.defectStep: ManualQuoteLevelAmountBasedLineLevel (BKM, actionType=ManualDiscount, ListContainer-group seq run after seq21) consumes InputUnitPrice=NetUnitPrice and AdjustmentValue=ItemDiscountAmount, outputting NetUnitPrice=InputUnitPrice-ItemDiscountAmount. The base is fed by SyncInputUnitPriceforDiscountBase/SyncInputUnitPricefromNet (top-level seq=13, AssignmentElement: InputUnitPrice <- NetUnitPrice). Root cause: for a DIRECT (non-partner) OneTime line, NetUnitPrice is never re-seeded back to ListPrice before discounting: 'OneTime Net Seed' (OneTimeNetSeedPrePartner seq19) uses IF(NetUnitPrice>0, NetUnitPrice, InputUnitPrice) so it PRESERVES the prior non-zero net, and 'Reset Net to Pre-Partner Base' (StampContributorBasePreDiscount seq14) only resets to ListPrice when PartnerDiscountPercent>0 (false here). So the persisted discounted net carries forward as the discount base and the $5000 compounds -$5000 on every reprice.
